scope: W07 six-family mechanism screening; no formal production

F1.evidence: H2/H4 surface RMSE converged near 0.04 m; H1 and pressure errors were non-monotonic.
F1.blocking_gap: impact pressure and near-gate H1 are not production validated

F2.evidence: Nine partial-capture and three complete-miss cases; five near-receiver cases have zero numerical loss.
F2.blocking_gap: cup-lip topology, resolution sensitivity, and external observation are absent

F3.evidence: Fine resolution recovers the first pressure-peak magnitude (3.045 versus 3.683 kPa), but timing remains 45 ms late.
F3.blocking_gap: coarse and medium impact pressure are unresolved

F4.evidence: Three qualitative topology probes completed with retained identities.
F4.blocking_gap: no external validation or resolution study

F5.evidence: The coarse wave-runup probe failed catastrophically; a refined probe is exploratory only.
F5.blocking_gap: run-up/overtopping observation anchor and stable resolution envelope are absent

F6.external_anchor: Fekken 2-D floating-cylinder displacement at dp=0.10/0.075/0.05 m
F6.evidence: Displacement RMSE improved from 0.353 to 0.0765 m with refinement.
F6.blocking_gap: SPHERIC Test 14 custom 3-D moving-body case remains unresolved

screening_decision.reason: Current gaps are validation, resolution, observation cadence, and protocol gaps; more coarse visual probes would not close them.

next_gate: W08 must convert selected axes into explicit train/interpolation/extrapolation groups without authorizing the 144-card matrix.
